claims.text: Pod phase Running means its containers were created and at least one still runs; when PostgreSQL is unreachable the api process keeps running (Pods stay Running) while requests that need the database fail with 500 (exception turned into 500 by ExceptionHandlingMiddleware).
claims.source_hint: Program.cs@stage-2 (ExceptionHandlingMiddleware); Pod status reflects the container process, not the app's dependencies

claims.text: Program.cs@stage-2 registers builder.Services.AddHealthChecks().AddDbContextCheck<DonHangDbContext>(tags: ["ready"]) with a comment that Redis is left out on purpose (lines 75-80).
AddDbContextCheck adds a check whose DbContextHealthCheck calls EF Core's CanConnectAsync, i.e. whether it can connect to the database.
claims.source_hint: learn.microsoft.com: Health checks in ASP.NET Core (Entity Framework Core DbContext probe: 'calls EF Core's CanConnectAsync')

claims.text: MapHealthChecks(path, HealthCheckOptions) maps an endpoint; HealthCheckOptions.Predicate selects which registered checks run; Predicate = _ => false runs none; tags passed at registration can be filtered on.
claims.source_hint: learn.microsoft.com: Health checks in ASP.NET Core (Filter health checks; Predicate; tags; Separate readiness and liveness probes)

claims.text: With default options a health endpoint answers 200 when the result is Healthy and 503 when Unhealthy, with the status (Healthy/Unhealthy) as plaintext body.
claims.source_hint: learn.microsoft.com: Health checks (Customize the HTTP status code: Healthy 200, Unhealthy 503; default response writer plaintext)

claims.text: With no checks selected, a health endpoint reports Healthy whenever the app can respond at that URL.
claims.source_hint: learn.microsoft.com: Health checks ('The app is considered healthy if it can respond at the health endpoint URL')

claims.text: A Redis error counts as a cache miss in ProductCache, so the api still answers product reads from PostgreSQL without Redis (taught in backend.l2.cache-aside).
The health endpoints are mapped outside /api/v1 and without RequireAuthorization, so no signed-in user is needed.
health.sh@stage-2: get() sends GET from a temporary caddy:2.10.0 Pod with BusyBox wget -S, prints the status line and the body only if non-empty; BusyBox wget saves no body for non-2xx answers.
health.sh creates Pod api-no-db from ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-api:1.0.0 with ConnectionStrings__Default Host=db-missing and calls it by Pod IP (no Service selects it: no app label).
health.txt@stage-2: api live and ready 200 Healthy; api-no-db live 200 Healthy, ready HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable (no body printed).
Try it: wget -q -O - http://api:8080/health/ready from a temporary caddy:2.10.0 Pod in donhang prints Healthy; kubectl run --rm deletes the Pod.
claims.source_hint: kubectl run … caddy:2.10.0 -- wget against the deployed stage-2 backend

claims.text: Separating liveness (no checks) from readiness (dependency checks) means a database outage does not make the liveness endpoint fail.
claims.source_hint: learn.microsoft.com: Health checks (Separate readiness and liveness probes)

claims.text: Service api@stage-2 has no type (ClusterIP by default), no Ingress exists and kind-config.yaml has no port mappings, so the health endpoints are reachable only inside the cluster.
claims.source_hint: deploy/k8s/api.yaml, deploy/k8s/kind-config.yaml@stage-2; kubernetes.io Service ('ClusterIP ... default for type')

claims.text: The kubelet restarts a container after its liveness probe fails failureThreshold times in a row (default 3), not on a single failure (preview of the next lesson).
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Liveness, Readiness and Startup Probes (failureThreshold default 3)

claims.text: docker-compose.yml@stage-2: the api service's healthcheck sends GET /health/ready over bash /dev/tcp and greps Healthy.
Try it output: Healthy followed on the same line by pod "health-try" deleted from donhang namespace (body has no trailing newline; kubectl run --rm prints the deletion).
claims.source_hint: reviewer run with rv-health-try on kind donhang (kubectl 1.34.3)
